svg.title: One Load, Five Controlled Handoffs
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-verified-load-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: One Load, Five Controlled Handoffs; subtitle: Move from a credit-cleared shipper order to reconciled cash.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Applies to an authorized domestic property brokerage. Stage values indicate sequence, not load volume or conversion rates.; caption: Automate load matching, tracking, and invoice reconciliation; assign a named owner to identity, service, and payment exceptions.; stages: label: Qualify shipper and lane; value: Confirm credit before accepting the order; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record commodity, equipment, declared cargo value, pickup windows, accessorial terms, and shipper credit limit in the TMS before committing capacity.; label: Quote and reserve exposure; value: Price carrier cost and service burden; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Set the shipper rate against a documented carrier buy rate; reserve credit exposure for the entire invoice, not merely the expected brokerage spread.; label: Verify and tender carrier; value: Match authority, identity, driver, and equipment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Cross-check FMCSA records with Highway or RMIS, call a previously verified carrier contact, verify insurance with the issuer, and investigate identity mismatches before issuing the rate confirmation.; label: Track and resolve exceptions; value: Monitor pickup, transit, delivery, and evidence; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use TMS tracking events and exception alerts; confirm unexpected tractor, driver, or destination changes through trusted contacts and retain delivery evidence.; label: Reconcile and settle obligations; value: Match documents before releasing carrier payment; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match rate confirmation, proof of delivery, carrier invoice, and approved accessorials. Bill the shipper, pay under agreed terms, and retain required broker transaction records for three years under 49 CFR 371.3.

circle.title: label: Qualify shipper and lane; value: Confirm credit before accepting the order; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record commodity, equipment, declared cargo value, pickup windows, accessorial terms, and shipper credit limit in the TMS before committing capacity.

text.title: Record commodity, equipment, declared cargo value, pickup windows, accessorial terms, and shipper credit limit in the TMS before committing capacity.

circle.title: label: Quote and reserve exposure; value: Price carrier cost and service burden; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Set the shipper rate against a documented carrier buy rate; reserve credit exposure for the entire invoice, not merely the expected brokerage spread.

text.title: Set the shipper rate against a documented carrier buy rate; reserve credit exposure for the entire invoice, not merely the expected brokerage spread.

circle.title: label: Verify and tender carrier; value: Match authority, identity, driver, and equipment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Cross-check FMCSA records with Highway or RMIS, call a previously verified carrier contact, verify insurance with the issuer, and investigate identity mismatches before issuing the rate confirmation.

text.title: Cross-check FMCSA records with Highway or RMIS, call a previously verified carrier contact, verify insurance with the issuer, and investigate identity mismatches before issuing the rate confirmation.

circle.title: label: Track and resolve exceptions; value: Monitor pickup, transit, delivery, and evidence; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use TMS tracking events and exception alerts; confirm unexpected tractor, driver, or destination changes through trusted contacts and retain delivery evidence.

text.title: Use TMS tracking events and exception alerts; confirm unexpected tractor, driver, or destination changes through trusted contacts and retain delivery evidence.

circle.title: label: Reconcile and settle obligations; value: Match documents before releasing carrier payment; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match rate confirmation, proof of delivery, carrier invoice, and approved accessorials. Bill the shipper, pay under agreed terms, and retain required broker transaction records for three years under 49 CFR 371.3.

text.title: Match rate confirmation, proof of delivery, carrier invoice, and approved accessorials. Bill the shipper, pay under agreed terms, and retain required broker transaction records for three years under 49 CFR 371.3.
Assumptions: Applies to an authorized domestic property brokerage. Stage values indicate sequence, not load volume or conversion rates.
